name: execute
title: Execute raw Lix SQL
description:
Execute caller-provided Lix SQL against an authorized workspace branch. Omit branch_id to use the workspace default branch. Multiple statements run atomically, either unwrapped or inside BEGIN ... COMMIT, and return one result per executable statement. SQL can read or mutate any SQL-accessible branch data and bypasses file-tool safeguards.

The following reference DDL describes every SQL surface initialized in a fresh workspace. Lix SQL does not support DDL statements; use these CREATE TABLE signatures only to understand column names, semantic SQL types, and nullability. Signatures labeled as views are read-only engine views even though CREATE TABLE syntax is used to retain their typed schema.

```sql

  entity_pk JSON NOT NULL,
  schema_key TEXT NOT NULL,

  snapshot_content JSON,

  global BOOLEAN,
  change_id TEXT,
```

Workspaces can register additional schema-derived surfaces after initialization. Discover the complete runtime schema for the selected workspace and branch with:

```sql
SELECT
  t.table_name,
  t.table_type,
  c.column_name,
  c.data_type,
  c.is_nullable,
  c.ordinal_position
FROM information_schema.tables AS t
JOIN information_schema.columns AS c
  ON t.table_catalog = c.table_catalog
 AND t.table_schema = c.table_schema
 AND t.table_name = c.table_name
WHERE t.table_schema = 'public'
ORDER BY t.table_name, c.ordinal_position;
```

branch_id.description: Lix branch UUID. Omit to use the workspace default branch.
